findings.title: Retain FCD's local high-school-senior eligibility condition
findings.evidence: Both retained fcd-page and fcd-pdf state that the program offers scholarships to qualified local high school seniors. The condition is also visible on the inspected safe PDF page1. Row114 records residence, GPA, study focus and recipient limits but has no typed observation for the high-school-senior condition; its README summary and specific next action omit it.

findings.requiredFix: Add a source-scoped, held eligibility observation preserving the exact local high-school-senior wording, with exact excerpt, URL, artifact hash and locator. Preserve the parent's conditional homeschool category separately; do not infer a homeschool exclusion or current applicability. Carry the condition in README and record/seed next actions. Add an appropriate semantic verifier assertion and reconcile any changed field totals.

findings.title: Retain Clerk's graduating-senior and parent high-school scope
findings.evidence: The retained Clerk PDF explicitly requires a graduating senior. clerk-page describes a graduating Flathead County high school senior and separately a graduating high school senior attending an in-state college or university. Row115 captures destination-type conflict but does not retain the graduating-senior condition or parent Flathead County high-school scope in a typed eligibility observation. README and specific next action also omit them.
findings.impact: A supported applicant-stage condition and locally scoped parent statement are absent from the research reconciliation. The acknowledged incomplete official-information section does not make these readable statements unavailable.
findings.requiredFix: Add held, source-scoped eligibility observations for the PDF's graduating-senior requirement and the parent's Flathead County high-school wording, with exact excerpts, URLs, hashes and locators. Distinguish high-school location from applicant residence; do not infer county residency, resolve the destination conflict, or claim complete PDF inspection. Carry these conditions in README and record/seed next actions, assert them in the verifier, and reconcile changed field totals.
